title: canonical_bytes_for_log_entry is public API returning empty Vec — silent failure trap
description: core/src/canonical.rs exports canonical_bytes_for_log_entry() which returns Vec::new(). The actual log entry ID computation lives in group_log/append.rs::compute_entry_id() and a parallel copy in verify.rs tests. Scenario: a contributor (or future self) calls canonical_bytes_for_log_entry() for signing or hashing a LogEntry — gets empty bytes, produces a signature over nothing, which passes verification against any other entry also signed over nothing. No error, no panic. Fix: either replace the body with todo!() so it panics loudly if called, or delete the exported stub entirely and add a note pointing to compute_entry_id.
